What I bring

Design Capabilities

I work at the intersection of product thinking and systems design — creating interfaces that are visually refined and architected to scale across teams, products, and platforms.

01
Token Architecture & Figma Variables
I structure colour, spacing, radius, and typography as a 3-layer token system: primitive → semantic → component. In Figma, this lives as Variable collections with mode switching — light, dark, and brand themes update globally from a single source. Change one primitive and every component updates instantly.
Primitive tokensSemantic tokensComponent tokensFigma VariablesMulti-mode themes
02
Component Systems & Libraries
Every component follows atomic design principles — built with auto-layout, named variants, boolean and instance-swap properties. I cover all interactive states — default, hover, focus, disabled, error, loading, and empty — before any screen is considered complete. Naming conventions align directly to code.
Auto-layoutVariantsAtomic designAll states coveredNaming conventions
03
Cross-Platform & Enterprise Design
4+ years designing across mobile (iOS & Android), web, SaaS dashboards, and admin platforms — always within or alongside a design system. I understand Apple HIG and Material Design, and how one decision in a system ripples across products shared by multiple teams.
iOS · AndroidSaaS dashboardsApple HIGMaterial DesignAdmin panels
↗
Zero-ambiguity Developer Handoff
Annotated screens covering every interaction, state, and edge case. Responsive specs from 375 → 768 → 1440px. Design tokens exported for CSS variables or Tailwind config. Figma Dev Mode enabled — engineers implement 1:1 without a single follow-up call.
◉
Research-led, Systematic Thinking
I start with user research, competitive audits, and jobs-to-be-done framing before touching Figma. Every decision is traceable to a user need or business goal. I document decisions — not just deliverables — so teams understand the rationale behind every pattern.
